'''Highmount Road''' was a roadway that ran through the [[Highmount Ridge]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], joining the [[Upper Pass]] and the [[Lower Pass]]. The [[Geothermal Substation]] was located at the southern end of the road, at the corner of Highmount Road and the Lower Pass.
